verdicts.reason: A uses a clear two-column layout: logo, headline, body, CTA and legal copy sit in one centered left stack, and the badge and bottle sit on the right. However, the headline wraps badly into four lines ('Make / the / longest / day last'), with lone words on the first two lines. The legal text is also oversized and competes with the body copy. B looks scattered: the logo floats on its own, and the 'LONGEST DAY SALE' badge is shrunk and stranded mid-left beside a stray circle. The body copy is squeezed to the left of the CTA in a cramped bottom row, and the fine print is pushed into the bottom-right corner circle, where a bokeh dot collides with it. The upper left is mostly empty, so the weight sits lopsided at the bottom.
